title: faaruu gaarreen yeroo galgalaa
intro: Gammoojjiin gabricha Rabbii filatamaa cinatti faaruudhaan yeroo sagalee dhageessisan dhaggeeffadhaa. Sagaleen kennaa faaruu, murtii falmitoonni gola sanatti barbaadanii fi sibiilli ajaja waaqaatiin lallaafaa ta’e argamuu eegu. Fakkiin waaqeffannaa fi bulchiinsa haqaa kamtu mallattoolee kanaan dubbata?
clues: Rabbiin arjummaa fi sagalee galata mi'aawaa ta'een eebbifame.
Afaan murtii haqaa falmitoota gidduutti kennamu akkan hubadhu Rabbiin na barsiise.
Lola keessatti loltuu guddaa jabaa tokkotu na mudatee fedhii Rabbiitiin isaan injifadhe.
Ogummaa, aangoo fi kitaabni faarfannaa buufame Rabbiin biraa naaf kenname.
Galgalaa fi yeroo aduun baatu na waliin Rabbiin ulfina kennuu keessatti gaarreen fi simbirroonni natti dabalaman.
Sibiilli naaf lallaafaa ta’e irraa kootii poostaa akkan fashion godhu Rabbiin na barsiise.

trial.answer: Fedhii Rabbiitiin lola irratti Jalut (Goliyat) injifate

Waraanni galaana keessatti liqimfamuu isaa mirkanaa'eera

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
